name: Save a valid enquiry and WhatsApp follow-up
description: Checks the existing public enquiry workflow.
steps: Confirm the saved state and WhatsApp link
expected: The enquiry is saved and a WhatsApp follow-up link is displayed.

name: Reject invalid enquiry details
description: Checks invalid contact details are rejected.
steps: Submit a name shorter than two characters or invalid phone
expected: The form rejects invalid details and does not save an enquiry.

name: Protect admin vehicle APIs
description: Private vehicle endpoints must reject signed-out and non-admin users.
steps: Request GET /api/admin/vehicles without an access token
expected: The backend returns an authentication or authorisation error and does not reveal inventory.

name: Manage vehicle listings and open the public detail view
description: Checks the authorised administrator can manage vehicles and visitors can open a listing detail view.
steps: Sign in with the authorised account
Open the vehicle card on the public page
Review its specifications and media areas
Mark it sold and confirm it is hidden publicly
expected: Vehicle CRUD remains restricted to the approved administrator; available vehicle cards open a detail view with the supplied gallery, future media areas and a vehicle-specific WhatsApp enquiry; sold listings are hidden publicly.

name: Use vehicle dashboard and public detail view on mobile
description: Checks the admin dashboard and vehicle detail experience are usable on a phone.
steps: Open the public vehicle card and review its detail view
expected: The dashboard and public detail view fit mobile screens and their controls remain usable.
